title.rendered: Grivamax Laser Cap Review vs Kiierr

content.rendered:
There are many products on the market today aimed towards replenishing your hair. From topical treatments, medications, and hair transplants, those suffering from androgenetic alopecia have many options to help get their hair back. However, rather than opting for the traditional methods for hair growth, an amazing technology is now available to use in the comfort of your home.

Low level laser light therapy was once only accessible through clinics, but now you can achieve the same amazing results in the comfort of your own home. Not only is it convenient, but it actually works to regrow hair follicles on the scalp!

There are several different hair growth products on the market today, so it is important to know the details about each of them so you can confidently make your purchase. Below I will go over in detail the companies of Grivamax laser cap review vs Kiierr to give you some more information. These laser cap reviews will reveal the importances of each brand.

Grivamax Laser Cap Review?

What is the Grivamax Laser Cap?

The Grivamax laser cap uses low level light therapy in their hair growth caps to revitalize and rejuvenate your hair follicles. Their caps increase both thickness and density of hair follicles, resulting in thicker, fuller, and healthier hair according to their website. Givamax offers a one year warranty on their products.

The Grivamax laser cap is worn for a 7-minute time period. You can start seeing new hair growth results after several months of religious, every other day use based off of their website information. Grivamax offers a money back guarantee if you do not see results after using the product for at least 6-months.

Grivamax Laser Cap Options and Details

Grivamax has three different laser caps to choose from. They are as follows:

1.) Grivamax Laser Cap 148 Details:

  • Contains 148 laser diodes
  • Uses LLLT
  • $597

2.) Grivamax Laser Cap 272 Pro Details:

  • Contains 272 laser diodes
  • Uses LLLT
  • $797

3.) Grivamax 272 Pro7 Details:

  • Contains 272 laser diodes
  • Uses LLLT
  • $1,497+

    Comparing Grivamax Laser Cap Reviews vs Kiierr

    Kiierr and Grivamax are identical in laser diodes which is beneficial for both products. LED lights aren’t as preferred, and many hair growth caps use these in their product to make a cheaper cap. While LEDs promote skin health and can even support wound healing, the light being produced from the LEDs typically aren’t preferred for hair growth and don’t have the same capabilities of that of real laser diodes.

    A big difference between the two hair growth caps will be found in their guarantees, warranty and price. Kiierr offers a 7 month guarantee or your money back. Grivamax gives a 6 month guarantee.

    The warranties also differ between the two products. Kiierr gives a free two year warranty with each cap, allowing you to be confident and protected with your purchase. They also will send you a new unit, absolutely free, in case of any issues related to the cap. Grivamax on the other hand has a one year warranty, which has you less covered in case malfunction.

    The most major difference between Grivamax and Kiierr are the price points that each company sells the laser caps. Each company offers three different laser caps that you can choose from, one containing 148 diodes and the other two containing 272. The 148 and 272 Pro laser caps from each company are very similar in price. However, when you bump up to the upgraded 272 cap, Grivamax charges $1,497+ and Kiierr only charges $1,295. This is a huge gap in price for the same laser diode count!

Kiierr Laser Cap Reviews

Kiierr’s laser cap revitalizes your hair follicles, allowing your hair to grow back healthier and stronger. The cap is responsible for energizing aging cells and stimulating new hair growth on the scalp.

The laser cap is known for its convenient and portable use. You will wear the laser cap underneath a standard Kiierr ball cap that comes with your purchase, or a standard one of your own. The cap offers consistent scalp coverage and is worn for 30-minutes every other day. Customers can use the cap at whatever point in the day that is most convenient for them, and can be used while running errands, on a walk, or doing chores around the house.

You will have the option between three different caps when looking to begin your hair growth journey. One cap contains 148 medical grade laser diodes and the other two contain 272 medical grade laser diodes. The more lasers a cap contains, the more effective the results will be in a shorter amount of time.

Kiierr Review Continued

It is also important to look at what types of lasers are throughout the caps. As you may know, medical grade laser diodes are the most effective laser when it comes to stimulating hair growth. Some caps contain LEDs, which do not penetrate deep enough into the scalp to revitalize the hair follicles and are not typically recommended for increasing hair growth.

The prices of the Kiierr caps range from $595-$1,395 depending on what cap you choose and whether or not you decide to purchase the fabulous hair growth supplements with the cap in the complete system. These affordable hair growth systems can help you see visual hair growth in as little as 3-months. Not to mention, if you are not satisfied with the cap and your results after using religiously for atleast 7-months, you can return the item for your full refund.

Conclusion: Laser Hair Cap Review

Grivamax and Kiierr reviews might be similar in laser diodes, but when it comes down to being protected and having successful hair growth, Kiierr has you covered. They make sure you feel confident in your purchase with them and that you’re protected in case of malfunction. And the best part is, their caps work amazingly well. This is indicated in the 7-month growth guarantee and free 2 year warranty which provides more coverage than Grivamax.

Kiierr’s laser caps also prove to be a more affordable option. This one time payment can get you a laser cap device to help you grow your hair in as little as 4-months. If needed, you can also purchase through a payment plan. We, here at Kiierr, cannot wait to help you get started on your hair growth journey today!
